chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, only forbade that any Muslim relieve himself beneath a tree or a palm tree that has borne fruit, because of the place of the angels entrusted with it.
He said: And for that reason the trees and the palm trees are in a state of intimacy when their fruit is upon them, because the angels are present with them.

key_terms.خَلَاءَهُ: his relieving himself; going to defecate or urinate
key_terms.نَهَى: forbade; indicates a prohibition or disapproval in conduct
key_terms.ٱلْمُوَكَّلِينَ: those appointed or entrusted with a charge

ai.seo_question: Why did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbid relieving oneself under a fruit-bearing tree?
ai.summary: This hadith states a prohibition against relieving oneself beneath fruit-bearing trees and palms. The reason given is the presence of angels appointed over them, linking legal etiquette with an unseen sacred dimension.
